text:
sara-sales: Quick heads-up — AtlasWave (search startup) wants a 2-week POC. They want to test our atlaswave-llama30b + q4hf variant for rerank + generative signals. Main asks: KV cache behavior with quantized weights, expected p95 latency at 512 token context, and a ballpark Dedicated pricing. They attached a security questionnaire (link).

evan-ml: short answer: q4hf supports KV cache, but expect ~15-20% throughput drop vs fp16 on long contexts due to dequant overhead. p95 latency at 512 tokens is ~120-140ms/token on our p4d-like profile with batching=8; single-request latency can be lower. If you give QPS/context mix I can produce a small perf matrix.

maria-solutions: Can you put that into a one-pager with recommended batch/cache settings + a pricing sketch? I'll handle the commercial side and respond to the sec q. Also confirm: do we support customer-managed keys for a POC on Dedicated/Private?

jules-privacy: Notes for sec questionnaire: they asked about data storage. For a standard POC: default retention = 7 days, can disable prefix caching on request. Customer-managed KMS requires Dedicated or Private (we can't do CMK on hosted control plane). Also need to include SOC2/ISO references in the answers — I'll attach cert links.

sara-sales: They prefer Hosted initially but are OK with Dedicated if KMS is required. Evan — can you paste a recommended config snippet we can share and call out fallback options if perf regresses?

evan-ml: sure — paste below:
```
recommended_config:
  model: atlaswave-llama30b-q4hf
  batch_policy: dynamic
  batch_target: 8
  max_context: 1024
  kv_cache: enabled
  cache_policy: prefix-only
  autoscale: min=2,max=8
  quant_profile: q4hf-default
  notes: Dedicated recommended for CMK; enable canary rollout with fp16 fallback
```

ops-bot: capacity-check: dedicated pool "east-1-dedicated-small" has 4/8 GPUs free for the next 14 days. Reservation recommended for stable POC throughput. :white_check_mark:

maria-solutions: Draft pricing (internal): estimated committed monthly for POC = $9,500 (equivalent of 2 reserved GPUs). Offer POC discount 50% for month 1. I'll send a formal quote to @sara-sales to pass to client.

sara-sales: Sending one-pager + answers to client now. They asked if we can start next Monday — can eng fast-track a canary with automatic fallback to fp16 if p95 > 200ms? Also they asked about SSO for their engineer to access logs.

evan-ml: Yes — we can configure a rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48 hours with auto-fallback threshold p95>200ms. SSO is supported for Dedicated/Private via SAML; we'll need an SP metadata file from their IdP. Also require a signed DPA before giving account-level access.

jules-privacy: I'll queue the DPA template and handle the questionnaire verification once Maria's answers are in. Flagging IP carve-outs requested by the customer — passing to legal.

maria-solutions: Got it. I'll update the one-pager with Evan's numbers, attach the KMS/SSO notes, and finalize the sec questionnaire answers. Posting back to thread when done. :thumbsup:

sara-sales: Perfect — thanks all. I'll loop in the customer's infra lead and ask for QPS estimates and IdP metadata.
